label: Train
depicts: Rounded train vehicle with three window panels above a flat track line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a side view train with a rounded nose and visible windows.
avoid_when: Do not use for the front facing trains when the long side view silhouette matters.

label: Train
depicts: Front train vehicle with a display bar two lights and outward track lines
use_when: Use when the interface wants a head on train with a display panel and two lower lights.
avoid_when: Do not use for the striped or slanted windshield trains when the display bar is the main cue.

label: Train
depicts: Front train vehicle with two horizontal bars and one round light
use_when: Use when the interface wants a head on train marked by two horizontal bands across the body.
avoid_when: Do not use for the display bar or windshield variants when the twin stripes matter visually.

label: Train
depicts: Rounded front train vehicle with a slanted window panel and two bottom lights
use_when: Use when the interface wants a head on train whose main cue is the slanted windshield panel.
avoid_when: Do not use for the striped or display bar trains when the windshield shape matters most.

label: Attachment
depicts: Tilted paper clip with two long parallel loops
use_when: Use when the interface wants the most familiar tilted paper clip shape for attachments.
avoid_when: Do not use for the hooked or upright clips when the diagonal double loop should remain visible.
